sincere.text: We’d already refunded that coffee and it was still on the trial sales sheet. Good thing you checked the receipt. I nearly took those numbers to my boss.

partner.text: Page one’s in. Next time I take the MRT, I’m counting how many people actually walk past that wall.

sincere.text: The shelf was empty for three days. Good thing you checked the delivery slip. HQ was about to figure nobody wanted it.

partner.text: Page two’s in. I put the stockout dates next to those three zeroes before that red line ends up in another deck.

sincere.text: I was still figuring out what to tell Finance. Then you checked the order number and it turned out we’d circled the same sale on both sheets.

partner.text: Page three’s in. I know 0317 by heart now. Both reports really did count it.

sincere.text: I nearly told the client people were booking viewings off a count of how often the form opened. Good thing you asked for the branch’s records.

partner.text: Page four’s in. I can bump that green line three ticks just by opening the form three times. No wonder the chart looks so good.

sincere.text: My boss wanted more coupons printed. I was about to put in the order. Seeing the numbers with the returns taken out gave me the nerve to ask him to wait.

partner.text: Page five’s in. We handed out coupons and showed people how to pour the refills that Saturday. I can’t tell which helped from the register sheet alone.

sincere.text: I bought that thirty percent jump, too. Then you checked the payments and showed me that hitting retry adds another row.

partner.text: Page six’s in. No wonder the stores didn’t cook more pearls. Hitting retry doesn’t pay for another drink.

sincere.text: You were still at the shrine and the report said another customer had come in? That explains why I didn’t see anyone over here.

partner.text: Page seven’s in. When you scanned the code on the red chair, another hit came in. The register didn’t make a sound.

sincere.text: I didn’t get the whole story until I saw that invoice. She’d asked her grandson to buy it after watching TV the night before. He clicked for the coupon the next day.

partner.text: Page eight’s in. I added the airtime and order time for that soy sauce. A night apart, and all the report had was one click.

sincere.text: I almost walked in with that chart. It took you matching the tickets for me to see the customer was still waiting to make a return.

partner.text: Page nine’s in. One ticket threw three close events. I left the case ID right beside them.
